title: Karaoke Club 01 — basement inside a complete building
purpose: Transparent central illustration for a red Machi Koro-style Karaoke Club card variant.
generation_prompt: Мультяшное целое двухэтажное провинциальное здание с крышей, караоке 1990-х в полуподвале. Лестница вниз под козырьком, маленькие светящиеся окна, за ними поющие скуфы с микрофонами, телевизор и диско-шар. Вид снаружи три четверти, стиль настольной игры, белый фон, широкие поля, без текста.
research_basis: Specialized Russian karaoke venues appeared in the mid-1990s, including basement locations.
Early systems used laser discs, wired microphones, CRT displays, and small song selections.

integration_context.target_use: Generate only the central illustration; it will be composited onto the existing red card template.
integration_context.background_requirement: Generate on an ordinary white background. Save the original, then locally remove the background to produce a separate transparent PNG.
integration_context.text_policy: Absolute no-text rule: no letters, numbers, words, song codes, labels, signage, logos, screen lyrics, graffiti, or pseudo-writing anywhere. Use only a microphone pictogram above the entrance.
integration_context.orientation: Front facade faces slightly right, the building's left side is visible, and depth recedes toward image left.

style_goal.core: Same polished cartoon board-game language as the approved Karaoke Club card: chunky toy-like forms, rounded expressive adult caricatures, crisp dark outlines, clean flat colors, simple cel shading, low-to-moderate detail.
style_goal.palette: Cold concrete gray, faded burgundy, nicotine beige, dim amber, electric violet and cyan accents.

content.subject: A complete two-story provincial building housing a 1990s basement karaoke club.
content.description: An exterior view of an entire two-story worn provincial building with complete roof, facade, side wall and foundation. A staircase under a canopy descends into a semi-basement karaoke venue. Small lit basement windows offer partial glimpses of stocky middle-aged men singing into wired microphones, a bulky CRT television and a mirrored disco ball. The upper floor has ordinary small windows. The structure is fully enclosed, not a cutaway room.
recognition_details: stairs descending below ground under a canopy
stocky men singing into microphones glimpsed through glass
CRT television and mirrored disco ball inside
content.miniature_base: A compact cracked-concrete slab with basement steps and a short metal railing, isolated on transparency.

Вид снаружи три четверти, стиль настольной игры, белый фон, широкие поля, без текста.
